item.title: Simplicity is the new sophistication
item.description: How an 8GB downloads folder turned into a bloated 27-service server, and how the v5 rewrite stripped it back to raw primitives.
item.content:encoded: How an 8GB downloads folder turned into a bloated 35k-line MCP server, the rate limit hell of early agent tools, and stripping it down for the stateless v5 era. Full essay at https://kridaydave.com/posts/simplicity-is-the-new-sophistication.html

item.title: Multi-agent coding loops will wreck your git history
item.description: Standard git merges are line-based and blind. When multiple agents edit one repo, you need intent locks and AST verification, not just rebase loops.
item.content:encoded: Standard git merges are line-based and blind. When multiple agents edit one repo, you need intent locks and AST verification, not just rebase loops. Full essay at https://kridaydave.com/posts/multi-agent-git-chaos.html
